text: Sovico Group, Japan's Mizuho Bank sign deal to expand financial cooperation

TOKYO - Việt Nam's Sovico Group and Japan's Mizuho Bank have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to strengthen financial connectivity, promote investment opportunities and expand economic cooperation between the two countries.
The agreement was signed on Thursday on the sidelines of the Việt Nam-Japan Public-Private Forum on Economic, Science and Technology Cooperation, according to Sovico Group.
Under the MoU, the two sides will explore financial solutions to support Sovico's business activities and potential projects, while facilitating access to Japanese and international capital markets.

They will also explore cooperation in green finance and funding solutions aligned with sustainable development goals, as well as participate in bilateral business forums, high-level dialogues and investment networking events to foster ties between the two countries' business communities.

Phạm Khắc Dũng, vice chairman of Sovico Group, said the partnership would expand the group's international financial and investment connections and create opportunities for long-term business cooperation between Việt Nam and Japan.
Sovico expects the agreement to improve its access to Japan's financial network, support joint initiatives and promote sustainable business growth, the company said.

Mizuho Bank, part of Mizuho Financial Group, is one of Japan's major financial institutions, providing banking and financial services to corporate and institutional clients through a global network. - VNS
